title: What Air-Fuel Carbon Recyclers Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Air-fuel carbon recyclers close the loop: capturing CO2 from air and converting it back into fuels and chemicals — recycling carbon instead of extracting more. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Air-Fuel Carbon Recyclers: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.

Why it matters: Recycled carbon displaces fossil extraction; the loop, not the well..
Where it is used: e-fuels, chemicals, plastics, aviation..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
